parental-controls.answer: The stable parental-controls guide explains Kids Profile setup, restricted server identities and the household Parental PIN. Kids profiles disable external Discovery, not every mature title. The PIN protects restricted settings and switching from a Kids profile to a non-Kids profile. Switching between Kids profiles does not require the household PIN; a destination Profile Lock still protects entry. Library hiding is not account-wide access control, and shares have no server maturity filter. Standalone playlist approval requires the Kids profile, TV Sources authorization and a second PIN entry for Approve this source. It grants the whole source locally. IPTV accounts added through IPTV provider are automatically enrolled as server sources, which LiveTVSourceAuthorization.filtering does not filter; they have no standalone approval control. Enable only suitable accounts in Settings > Libraries and inspect channels and on-demand titles. Converting a standalone playlist does not transfer its approval protection. Use a restricted Seerr identity and check content, restrictions and automatic sign-in on every device.

apple-tv-user-sign-in.answer: Select each Apple TV user, authorize the desired Plozz profile, then enable Settings > Profiles > Automatically Sign In. The shared roster and server sign-ins do not make active selection or the trusted startup session shared: those remain system-user-local and opt-in. Manual switches and changed trust still require authorization; this is not a name match or server-user creation. Plex Home's production-enabled offline sign-in proof uses nonsynchronizable, system-user-dependent Keychain storage, so an online sign-in under the current Apple TV user is required before locally verifying the unchanged saved Home-user PIN during a network failure. This is separate from the mobile Offline Mode toggle and cannot authorize a new binding or rejected credential. With automatic sign-in off, background browsing triggers profile selection on return immediately when any profile is locked or bound to a protected Plex user, otherwise after five minutes with multiple profiles; one unlocked profile does not trigger it. Video/music/live playback, external-player departure and inactive-only interruptions do not trigger this browsing return check.

combined-library-browsing.answer: All Libraries pages enabled non-music libraries across accounts on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad, preserving original-server ownership and merging matching identities where possible. More than one browsable library is required for its shortcut. All TV layouts support eligible shortcuts; mobile library shortcuts start hidden. In Screens & Navigation > App navigation > Hide or Reorder Navigation, hold All Libraries and choose Show, then open it from navigation or compact More. Individual mobile libraries can be shown there too; hiding shortcuts does not disable content. Choose an accessible copy through the title's server/version selector, in TV's header More actions when offered. Combined Home rows remain independent.

continue-watching-retention.answer: The Continue Watching row, including merged Next Up titles, does not impose an age or card-count cutoff on available history. This does not guarantee unlimited history retention: LocalMediaWatchStore keeps at most 2,000 newest records per profile/source store, fewer when needed to fit its payload budget. Old share resume positions and watched marks can therefore disappear as new history is saved. Provider queries and retained server history also determine available titles. ContinueWatchingPolicy.admits excludes trailers and invalid positions. Started videos need min(60, max(5, duration * 0.05)) seconds, or 60 seconds when duration is unknown; saved resume progress is independent. Zero-position episodes remain eligible as unstarted Next Up suggestions. Separate Next Up rows preview up to 20 titles, not the complete feed. Account-wide history queries ignore disabled library browsing switches, but watched/dismissal state, account inclusion and server-user authorization still apply. Include Next Up defaults on in Screens & Navigation > Home > Rows > Continue Watching; turn it off for separate rows. Removing Continue Watching suspends merging, while Continue Watching settings remains reachable in Rows.

alphabet-navigation.answer: In an Apple TV name-sorted title browse, scroll a few rows down to reveal the indexed letter rail and focus a letter to jump. Collection members and other sorts do not qualify. Combined or Silo jumps load on demand; select the letter again after a failed jump, or change sort away and back to name to rebuild a failed index. Mobile now has a wired All Libraries destination, but its grid still has feedback/destination hooks without a constructed alphabet menu or rail entry point. Use mobile filters, scrolling or Search instead.

top-shelf.answer: Put Plozz in Apple TV's top Home Screen row. From an adult profile, Settings > Everyone > Top Shelf offers default-on Show Top Shelf, Posters (default) or Full Screen and independent 1-20 Continue Watching/Recently Added counts, defaulting to four each. Full Screen expands with tvOS swipe-up; the first carousel action requests playback and the second opens details without autoplay. These actions have OS-owned captions, not verified app labels. Poster selection requests playback. Preferences stay device-local across Plozz profiles; disabling clears media but retains choices. A saved, access-scoped Home snapshot is not live browsing; short feeds are not padded, same-source repeats deduplicate in Full Screen, and authorization/source failures remain visible. Artwork and full-screen spoilers respect profile policy.

community-skip-markers.answer: Enable Settings > Playback > Skip intros, credits & more, then open Customize. Default behavior offers Show skip button, Skip instantly or Skip after (1-30 seconds); Enable for controls movie/TV/anime eligibility. Each marker opens category-specific rules, including Off or Use default to restore the shared behavior. Disabled categories must first be enabled on the previous page. Actions need markers. With skipping enabled, Use community markers (default on) checks IntroDB/TheIntroDB when server intro or credits markers are missing, filling missing marker kinds without replacing server markers. Requests send movie/series IMDb, TMDB or TVDB IDs plus applicable episode coordinates, ordering, episode name and runtime, not video files. Matching and database availability limit coverage. Turning this off stops community requests, not server-provided markers.

dual-subtitles.answer: For movies and episodes, select primary text, then another text track through Apple TV Style > Dual Subtitles (or its direct control) or mobile Subtitles > Advanced… > Second Track; Off there removes only the second track. Live TV excludes dual subtitles. Mobile portrait starts in the ellipsis Playback options menu, while landscape separates controls. AetherEngine can decode embedded second text tracks; native playback needs fetchable text delivery. Image primaries disable dual mode and images cannot be second tracks. Image-primary placement is a separate supported control: Bottom of video can move eligible lower dialogue while preserving its original font, colors, image size and fixed artwork. Locally remuxed wireless AirPlay has no selectable subtitles.

library-channels.answer: Open Live TV's TV Sources > Plozz channels; enable the automatic lineup or Create custom channel. Automatic channels are not individually editable; Retry Plozz channels recovers preparation errors and Refresh Plozz channels rebuilds prepared lineups. For custom channels set the name, order and Movies/Episodes choices, then select accessible Plex/Jellyfin/Emby/Silo libraries and optional semicolon-separated rules. Allowed ratings matches normalized exact classifications, not a maximum age; Include unrated titles defaults on and admits missing classifications independently of that list. Movie-only ordering disables Episodes. Preview schedule before Save channel; missing/invalid durations exclude titles and blank fields allow all matches. Changes start after published programs. The library catalogue must finish syncing before devices can reproduce the same schedule. Update watch history is profile-scoped, device-local and default-off; enabling it can mark programs watched after 90% actual viewing without resume writes. Both shells use the authorized completion mutation pipeline, so matching servers follow the cross-server history setting and connected video/anime trackers can receive eligible completions too. Playback uses original files, not IPTV or network-share sources. Silo requires allowed, available protocol-3 original_http support; its eligible single-file versions must have reliable duration/size and are revalidated before playback. Silo native Live TV remains a separate unsupported source type. Select a saved custom-channel name to edit; its Delete channel context action removes the channel without deleting library media.

offline-background.answer: On iPhone/iPad, choose Download from movie/episode details or Manage Seasons for available episodes. Review selection circles and open episode rows for versions: one recommended version starts selected, multiple episode versions save separate files, and movies allow one copy. Choose Versions adds a copy to a saved episode. Quality choices need support from all prepared items; Original Size requires known file sizes and Available shows device capacity. Ask Each Time defaults on; disabling it skips only single-item, single-version confirmation, never bulk/multiversion review. Streaming-service links are not downloadable. Wait for Downloaded in Downloads, not merely all bytes received or a Finishing Live Activity, and test video/audio/subtitles offline. While online, matching usable downloads can remain preferred after another server/version is selected. Offline Mode requires a saved copy of an explicitly selected version. Eligible HTTP transfers use background sessions; in-process/share transfers need the foreground unless continued processing is granted. Switching profiles pauses transfers; return to the owner to resume. iOS/iPadOS 26 Live Activities are optional and cancellation/expiry pauses work without deleting partial files. Network, speed, provider, storage and track limits still apply; Apple TV has no downloads. In Settings > Downloads, Offline Mode is the first feature-gated toggle; the profile picker's app-defined More menu offers it too. It is initially off, shared by profiles on this device and not synced. Enabling it pauses downloads, iCloud/network work and online tracking, replacing Home, library, Search and Watchlist content with authorized completed copies. Discover/Live TV cannot connect. Plex Home needs a prior online sign-in on this device for an unchanged binding, with any protected PIN checked locally; new identities and rejected credentials cannot use that proof. Turn the mode off and reconnect to retry saved progress updates. No Network Connection does not activate the mode; dismissing a notice changes no network or mode setting. New download settings use Use Cellular, Speed > Limit, In Background and Quality > Default/Ask Each Time. Original preserves embedded tracks. New reduced Plex/Emby/Silo copies retain all reported audio, though conversion can change formats and Emby preparation needs temporary space; Jellyfin may retain one audio track. Saved older preparations keep their original track choices on retry. Reduced Jellyfin and Emby preparations without all-audio support require Unlimited or Original, while new all-audio Emby transfers support the cap. Inclusion switches are absent. Completed video can remain usable after a sidecar warning. Update Subtitles/Retry Subtitles fetch sidecars without downloading video again, under foreground owner authorization and download network/rate policy. In a saved show, native Edit, Select All and Remove select and confirm deletion of local episode copies; Done clears selection. Top-level show menus retain Pause Show/Resume Show separately from season Pause/Resume.

cross-server-history.answer: Sync across all my servers in Trackers (mobile also exposes Sync watch state across servers in Playback) defaults on and propagates watched-state/resume updates to matching accessible copies. Apple TV enables its control when multiple servers exist. Turning it off keeps writes scoped to the originating server. This is distinct from CloudKit configuration/profile sync and from scrobbling to third-party trackers; server identities and permissions still govern delivery.

version-selection.answer: The first multi-version movie/episode asks How should versions be selected? Choose Ask every time, Choose automatically or Use first from server, and change it later under Settings > Playback > Version selection. Automatic selection weighs resolution, HDR, bitrate and device compatibility; How automatic selection works explains the ranking. With Remember series version choices enabled, a matching remembered type takes priority in automatic mode and is preselected in ask mode. Missing types fall back to the device recommendation without promising identical episode files. Use first from server follows the selected account's version order, excludes external-service shortcuts and ignores remembered choices; an explicit title/player version choice still wins. On mobile while online, a usable matching download takes precedence over streaming even with another source/version selected; check the saved edition rather than assuming a source switch forces streaming. Offline Mode requires a saved copy of an explicitly selected version instead of substituting a different downloaded version.

device-setup.answer: Choose Set up from another device on the receiver and send from the configured device's iCloud Sync screen over the same local network, allowing Local Network access. Use nearby selection, code or QR; camera permission is needed for scanning. Compare codes when prompted; same-account rendezvous can authenticate without that comparison. Only supported credentials transfer. Mobile iCloud Keychain can separately adopt supported server/share/Seerr logins; Apple TV uses pairing or sign-in instead and Silo always needs its own device approval.

App/PlozziOS/Info.plist.summary: Local Network permission supports discovery/pairing; Camera is used for setup QR scanning with code entry as an alternative. NSMotionUsageDescription explains device motion for Landscape auto: only the active authorized compact-phone full-screen player leases CoreMotion updates, allowing landscape direction changes even with system rotation lock enabled. Missing motion support falls back to system landscape rotation; this is not an iPad orientation picker or a guaranteed new permission prompt. Background audio/processing modes and download identifiers do not guarantee execution. The permitted external-stream.* identifier is wired through ExternalPlaybackExecution to an actual iOS/iPadOS 26 continued-processing grant, unavailable on tvOS/Catalyst. ExternalPlaybackRelay serves only authorized immutable regular share files and eligible SRT files over tokenized loopback URLs; it is not a LAN proxy or arbitrary upstream fetcher. Source/profile changes, grant expiry/cancellation, failure or returning Plozz to the foreground stop it. Custom apps, playlists, streaming-link/disc files and actual local downloads cannot use this relay. Infuse/VLC query schemes populate installed-player checks and the one-time Play in menu. The return URL routes through the mobile root and validated receipts into owner-authorized watch mutations, never arbitrary progress. Neither installation nor a background declaration bypasses source/launch eligibility.

App/PlozziOS/PlozziOS.branded.entitlemen.omitReason: Side-by-side development builds intentionally omit canonical cloud and associated-domain capabilities; these internal provisioning variants are not consumer setup features.

App/PlozziOS/PlozziOS.entitlements.summary: CloudKit/presence and pairing universal links are wired; supported mobile credentials use a separate synchronizable Keychain path rather than making all CloudKit server descriptors authenticated.

App/Resources/Info.plist.summary: The declared Guide-button activity is consumed by MainTabView only when Live TV is enabled, then opens the full-screen channel player's guide. Background audio uses the music controller and Now Playing session for screensaver listening and Control Center commands. External-app query schemes detect Native Player/Infuse/VLC; RootView routes the registered callback into nonce-, URL-, age- and authorization-validated receipts before AppState writes viewer-owned progress. External handoff is separate from AirPlay and Apple's in-app native engine. Native Player/Infuse/VLC scheme checks support the Apple TV detail Play in alternatives; Plozz can be chosen when another player is the default.

App/Resources/Plozz.branded.entitlements.omitReason: Empty entitlements belong to internal side-by-side development builds; production Apple TV user management and Top Shelf use the canonical entitlements instead.

App/Resources/Plozz.entitlements.summary: Canonical Apple TV capabilities support shared sign-ins and profile storage with system-user-local selection and opt-in automatic sign-in. The shared Plex Home model also keeps prior online-sign-in proof in nonsynchronizable, user-dependent Keychain storage: a network failure can permit local verification for the unchanged saved binding under this Apple TV user, without authorizing a new identity or rejected credentials. This does not expose the mobile Offline Mode toggle on Apple TV. CloudKit/push declarations do not establish dependable background execution: the root's foreground transition explicitly fetches enabled cloud sync.

TopShelf/ContentProvider.swift.summary: The extension renders the shared saved snapshot as native poster sections or a details carousel. Full Screen has distinct playback and details actions with OS-owned captions; both resolve only within admitted active accounts. The adult settings entry controls default-on visibility, style and per-feed counts on this device without broadening source permissions.

TopShelf/TopShelf.branded.entitlements.omitReason: This development-only Top Shelf extension deliberately lacks the canonical app group; it does not add a user-facing control or alternative setup procedure.

connections.summary: Connect supported media servers, approved Silo devices, IPTV accounts or wired share transports; shared sign-ins differ from profile library selection/server-user access. Manual Jellyfin/Emby checks prefer HTTPS, with eligible HTTP alternatives but no downgrade after explicit HTTPS or TLS rejection. Choose later defers initial library selection without declaring failed discovery empty. Libraries > Watching as or mobile identity controls select existing users; adding another sign-in does not create server users. Sign In Again validates the original account/server/profile without deleting a connection on failure/cancellation. Manage only trusted verified alternate addresses; HTTP is unencrypted, Silo reapproves and Tailscale needs manual entry on an already-connected playback device. WebDAV folder browsing does not establish seekable playback: the network-share section explains valid byte ranges and strong ETag/valid Last-Modified requirements, administrator checks and rescan/reopen after replacing files. Shared Sources > Add Source navigation replaces separate server/share add actions. IPTV guide preparation is independent of channel availability and has explicit status/recovery in the channel guide.

library.summary: Browse, filter, sort and search enabled libraries; All Libraries combines them on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad, with explicit mobile shortcut visibility explained in the combined-library capability. Only Apple TV exposes the name-sort letter rail. Genre/year intersect quick filters; preparation, interrupted collections and failed facets retain cancellation/retry paths, including the exact Couldn't load filter options. Try Again menu action. Eligible Home row previews open a row-specific grid, not an unrestricted library query: TV uses a trailing See all card and mobile a heading chevron. Combined Recently Added, collection members and server recommendations retain their actual feeds; filter/sort changes load the remaining feed before publishing results, with Retry on failure. Watchlist shortcuts open the dedicated page and its saved preferences instead. Dedicated Discover is a separate non-Kids destination with five ordered paged feeds, not Home's hero or its See all grids. Available now requires a currently validated playable copy in enabled accessible libraries and hides both upcoming feeds; Hide watched uses known completion history. Both filters default off, save per profile, and offer Clear Filters; row failures offer Try Again. Seerr can supply feeds but is not required for browsing, and requesting does not grant playback. Collections, playlists, extras, IPTV on-demand catalogues and source/version selection remain distinct from requests and schedule-only placeholders. Watchlist covers save/removal, filters, date/name sorting, profile ownership and connected-list effects; disabling sources does not erase explicit saves. History actions distinguish watched-state changes from Continue Watching dismissal/resume clearing and cross-server delivery. Library tabs and Recommended rows differ from Home/main shortcuts; Browse is the fallback, shares lack Recommended, and collection-cover shapes have independent library/row scopes. Server-owned trailers/previews play in Plozz; Watch on YouTube opens externally regardless of external-player preference, requiring the TV app or mobile app/web fallback without guaranteeing availability. The Watch extras section explains source-dependent bonus videos, row retry, supported resuming and device/profile-local Plex fallback progress. Extras/trailers do not complete the main title, fan out to matching copies or scrobble trackers; trailers never enter Continue Watching. Share history persists locally per profile/device; dismissing a share preserves its resume position, and later playback can restore its card. Detail information supports full readers for truncated descriptions, facts and overflowing groups; Apple TV Back and mobile Done/close differ. Selected-file facts are not runtime diagnostics, and catalogue episode/season totals are not available/unwatched counts. Trailers & music now provides one shared profile destination for trailer-source policy, independent Home autoplay and detail Trailer/Theme music/Off choices. Server files from another accessible matching copy are preferred before external YouTube; policy Off removes trailer actions/autoplay while preserving non-trailer extras and theme music. Eligible Apple TV previews expand through Up with ordinary transport and temporary sound; Home requires Pinned Sidebar.

home-navigation.summary: Screens & Navigation separates Home layout/hero, Rows, Filtering, main shortcuts and movie/show details. Presets replace custom Home arrangements after confirmation without editing servers; collection sections retain source identity, presentation choices and failure recovery. Classic TV/mobile Home empty messages expose Dismiss and Customize Home. Dismiss saves a per-profile empty-message preference, not row removal or content filtering; new nonempty results can appear. Rows > the affected row > Show empty message reverses dismissal outside Showcase. Unavailable/failing rows retain Details and Retry; usable cached/partial rows can remain while diagnostics appear in the editor. The Home browsing guide explains eligible expanded rows separately from the arranger: TV See all cards versus mobile row headings, platform control order, original-feed membership and retry. Plain combined Continue Watching remains unbounded in its rail and does not gain this shortcut merely from its item count; Live TV rows are not row-browser feeds. History feeds ignore library discovery switches, with no age/count cap for eligible Continue Watching/merged Next Up and separate Next Up previews capped at 20. Brief-play eligibility is separate from resume storage; trailers are excluded. Recently Added and Hero & discovery filters are presentation-only with different defaults and candidate limits. Showcase and the carousel remain separate. Discovery recommendations do not require Seerr, but a new profile's carousel follows its connection until Discovery is explicitly toggled; Kids policy still excludes Discovery. All three TV navigation layouts offer eligible library shortcuts; changes retain saved order. Mobile starts with Home, Downloads and Search subject to availability; other destinations, including individual libraries and All Libraries, start Hidden until explicitly shown. Compact More contains overflow of shown destinations, not hidden shortcuts. TV sidebars retain Settings, Top Bar has a profile-picker escape, and mobile retains the profile-button route. Reset Navigation does not reset library tabs or access. Main layout/shortcuts stay local per profile/device; Home preferences transfer. Hero and Movie & show details link to the same Trailers & music destination; Home autoplay and detail backgrounds are separate profile choices. Landscape collection sections alone expose Logo On/Off, default Off, before Content and Row name.

appearance.summary: Keep themes, density, focus, artwork and language distinctions in one guide. Artwork > Customize by view offers per-area Library/Metadata providers choices, plus Mixed for title details; selecting another preset replaces overrides. Apple TV's contextual help illustrations are reachable and informational, not an omitted destination. Customize labels selects Page; Home/Recommended have page Default plus row Overrides. Mixed hides captions on series artwork and in TV Showcase. Continue Watching's Use default inherits its context; On/Off applies to both Home and Recommended. Home Libraries has its own override; contextual editors share the same preference store and collection/playlist members use Browse. On Apple TV only, Page > Movie & show details offers Only show descriptions on focus after Episodes; it defaults off, needs episode labels on and collapses unfocused episode synopses without relaxing spoiler policy. Watch indicators distinguish unstarted flags, completed checks and Hidden, separately from episode counts, count style and Show progress bars. Hiding marks/bars neither changes history nor clears resume; these profile-owned settings are transfer-allowlisted. Retain Liquid Glass, independent header sizes, profile artwork versus shared metadata sources, saved download artwork, and interface language versus media language/device region.

spoilers.summary: Spoiler Protection remains in Screens & Navigation > All screens, with platform labels, blur/placeholder, in-progress image/text differences, chapter masking and independently hidden/revealable review scores. Home > Rows > Continue Watching owns Artwork + logo/Thumbnail/Poster, Playback details and Labels; only Thumbnail uses episode stills. Labels now uses Use default for contextual inheritance, with On/Off shared across Home/Recommended. Progress only removes playback text but bars still respect the profile's independent Show progress bars preference. Hidden rows retain settings and Add row recovery. Card selection defaults to Play or can open details; TV Play/Pause remains direct. Presentation changes neither watched state nor membership.

circadian.summary: Set solar-region, manual or always-on dimming, adjust warmth and fade, preview a day, disable the effect, and separate profile-owned app tint from system or TV settings.

playback.summary: Use remote/mobile controls and same-account versions with Ask every time, Choose automatically or Use first from server; the third mode preserves server order and ignores independent series memory. Ask to resume or start over is a separate opt-in control: Resume shows remaining time and Start Over full runtime when known, independently of resume rewind. The shared prompt is wired through TV and mobile hosts without dropping the pending request. Keep autoplay, Up Next, marker/category rules and community privacy limits. Player tabs orders default-on Chapters, Cast, Episodes, Playlist and Continue Watching per profile, still requiring available content; Info is retained. Continue Watching uses loaded Home progress, excludes the current title and same-source show episodes, and switches to the selected authorized source/version and position. Song recognition defaults on per profile, uses Shazam and decoded playback audio rather than the microphone, and needs internet and a supported route; Offline Mode, native playback and remote bypass cannot supply it. Every match card opens Open song with Spotify search, conditional Apple Music, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, Deezer and TIDAL searches. TV universal-link failure shows a phone QR code; mobile opens an app/browser. The focused song guide distinguishes recognition from service access and library music. Chapters needs usable source/file chapters; images are optional, zoom is session-only, and cast-page navigation ends playback. The external-player reference explains compatible original/converted streams from supported servers, eligible on-demand IPTV and share routes, mobile quality limits, token/password sharing, fallback and authorized progress returns. Mobile share relay requires a real OS continued-processing grant and stops on foreground return, cancellation/expiry or authorization changes. Network-share BDMV folders add profile-level Disc playback and a held detail play-button alternative. HDMV menus use directions/select and explicit return/close actions, Retry and region recovery; production does not support BD-J menus. Disc videos lists dynamic numbered playlists with durations/chapters, starts selected entries at zero, and invalidates after source changes. Menu/selected-playlist playback suppresses title progress, history, trackers, skipping and autoplay; Play video restores ordinary viewing. Held Play in is one-time, not a new default.

quality.summary: Set profile-owned mobile network defaults or a Video > Quality session limit. Maximum removes the app's reduction limit, not server compatibility decisions; lower limits permit originals only with fitting known dimensions/bitrate, otherwise conversion can be required. Custom limits take a supported resolution and whole-number total Kbps; invalid saved limits must be replaced rather than treated as Maximum. HEVC preference can fall back to H.264 at the same limit. Playing in SDR identifies an SDR conversion; Current stream uses active facts, Declared stream bitrate is not throughput, and missing facts remain Not available. Preserve server permission/capacity, Silo resolution/codec limits and forced-conversion recovery. Compatible converted streams can now hand off to an external player; mobile quality limits remain in the preparation request rather than being bypassed. Native routes with separate audio or incompatible authorization still stay in Plozz. Device-local Video buffer applies on new sessions across all platforms, not quality/downloads, with space/native-path limits; Live TV buffer is a separate cushion, not recording.

audio.summary: Select tracks/language; series memory stores language, not an exact commentary track, codec or mix, and can follow matched series across servers. Playback > Audio exposes default-on Prefer lossless audio in both shells. Turning it off requests AetherEngine's compressed surround-compatible output, useful for regular HDMI ARC. The adapter samples it for on-demand/live loads, not native-engine or external-app playback; reopen video/retune after changes. Actual output depends on source/equipment. It is shared across Plozz profiles on this device and excluded from sync/transfer. The same Audio page includes profile-owned, default-on Identify songs. Its reader task is answered in playback's song-identification section and linked from Audio: ShazamKit consumes played audio, never the microphone, and needs internet, Offline Mode off and a decoded-audio-capable route. A match appears with Info; an Apple Music URL is optional and requires that service's access. Retain no adjustable engine audio delay, opt-in mobile Background Audio/data use, and output-gated TV Reduce Loud Sounds/Enhance Dialogue with system-wide scope and Settings recovery. Screens & Navigation > Movie & show details > Trailers & music > Details > Detail background > Theme music plays through the shared controller on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad. Theme music volume is 0%-100%; adjusting it can preview automatically and Play preview/Stop preview provide explicit control. Preview resolution checks authorized Home titles, then can use a generated sample if none supplies a theme; a preview is not universal title availability. Leaving the page stops the preview. Detail music fades in/out, pauses outside the app, and yields to trailers/full playback. The mobile detail speaker button toggles Mute theme music/Unmute theme music only during active detail playback; session mute changes neither saved volume nor Settings previews and resets on leaving that detail. Off selects static detail art independently of Home trailers and video tracks. Trailer-source Off does not disable theme music; Home autoplay and video tracks are independent.

subtitles.summary: Select/search tracks, distinguish forced/SDH and per-content policies, enter mobile language codes or follow device language, style text or Live TV, and manage second tracks. Mobile Subtitles > Advanced… contains Second Track, Subtitle Delay and Appearance > Style; Search & Download… opens search separately. Portrait starts in Playback options. Prefer SDH permits fallback; Only SDH makes automatic/search/download choices strict without overriding manual or remembered choices. Matching device caption style replaces custom appearance after confirmation; appearance edits leave matching, but control-avoidance-only edits preserve it. Position selects Bottom of screen or Bottom of video, and Vertical offset measures upward from that reference; Extra Line Position offers Above/Center/Below for wrapped-line growth, not second-track placement. Default-on Auto-Move Away from Controls follows those placement controls in both editors, lifts colliding Plozz-rendered text/eligible image captions while controls are visible, and returns them when controls disappear; disabling allows overlap. The picture-placement section retains active-picture detection with video-frame fallback, lower-dialogue image movement preserving size/fixed artwork, and file-formatting overrides. Explain embedded AetherEngine versus fetchable native text, image-primary exclusion, secondary Off, timing and AirPlay limits. External apps receive eligible fetchable SRT sidecars without Plozz styling/dual guarantees; custom templates receive no subtitle links.

music.summary: Find Apple TV music from supported server libraries, start album/playlist sessions, use shuffle/repeat and the scrolling current-track card to reopen Now Playing, continue listening through the screensaver and use Control Center Now Playing transport controls. Trace background audio through the controller and shared system-command session. Explain synchronized lyrics and Last.fm eligibility without promising mobile music or downloads. LRCLIB requests can send title/artist/duration, not audio; MusicTabView gates future LRCLIB work on NowPlayingView's shared device toggle. While lyrics are enabled but unavailable, the toggle is disabled, so switch it off on a track with usable lyrics; switching back on triggers resolution. This is separate from profile-owned tracker authorization. AudioPlaybackController admits only nonempty synchronized lyrics, despite plain-text support in the model/view, so omit plain-lyrics instructions as unwired.

live-tv.summary: Set up IPTV or server channels using direct M3U catalogues rather than web pages or single-stream HLS. EPG URL (optional) accepts XMLTV; Advanced options adds guides, authentication and separate playlist/stream versus guide headers. Guide headers apply to the first guide URL's server; empty fields follow playlist credentials. Prefer HTTPS. Distinguish device-local IPTV account file imports from encrypted standalone source-copy sync. Current IPTV accounts expose Refresh guide and household Sources > Edit connection, not standalone Playlist and guides, guide mapping, identity repair or availability scans. Standalone Kids approvals grant the whole playlist locally; IPTV accounts are enrolled as server sources and do not use that approval, so account selection and content review remain essential. Connect as IPTV account preserves the older source/preferences but not its approval protection on the new account; disable the duplicate source afterward. Category overrides, country-OR-language filtering, individual hiding and scan exclusions have distinct recovery paths. Identity restoration requires same-station/feed confirmation and carries favorites, hiding and mappings. Guide retention is not recording. Search tunes the live channel rather than replaying a program. Multiview supports four pictures subject to provider limits, with focus-selected audio on Apple TV and Audio on mobile. Auto preview and Keep watching while browsing are TV-only; Preview after watching is shared. Mobile network restrictions react to detected changes and may briefly use cellular; Low Data Mode pauses Live TV even on Wi-Fi. Library channels admit eligible Plex/Jellyfin/Emby/Silo originals, not native Silo TV. Automatic channels offer Retry/Refresh but are not individually editable. Custom channels need valid durations, exact-rating rules and explicit handling of unrated titles; schedules wait for already-scheduled programs and catalogue sync. History is default-off, profile-scoped and device-local; 90%-viewed completions use normal cross-server/tracker updates without resume writes. Live TV buffer trades tuning latency for a new-load cushion, respects Go Live, and is not recording or buffering for scheduled library files. Authorized account guide updates report stage progress across navigation; dismissing is not cancellation, and Guide ready does not promise every channel/date.

offline.summary: On iPhone/iPad, review available episodes/versions and quality, wait for Downloaded and test video/audio/subtitles offline. Ask Each Time does not suppress bulk or multiversion review. Online playback can prefer a usable matching download; Offline Mode needs the explicitly selected version saved. Settings order is Offline Mode, Network, Speed, Quality, Notifications, In Progress and Storage. Original preserves embedded tracks; new reduced Plex/Emby/Silo copies retain all reported audio, though formats can change and Emby preparation needs temporary space. Jellyfin reduced copies may retain one audio track. Saved older preparations keep their track choices on retry, and reduced Jellyfin/some Emby copies cannot use a speed cap. New all-audio Emby transfers support caps. No new-download audio/subtitle inclusion switches exist. Supported text sidecars have per-file, total-size and count limits; partial warnings keep usable video. Downloads and saved-show episode menus offer Update Subtitles/Retry Subtitles without retransferring video, requiring the foreground authorized owner, online mode and download network/rate policy. Old preparations excluding text omit it. In a saved show, native Edit opens episode selection, Select All and Remove allow confirmed bulk deletion, and Done clears selection. Season controls remain separate from top-level Pause Show/Resume Show. Background HTTP differs from in-process/share work; iOS 26 continued processing is an OS decision and Finishing is incomplete. Activity cancellation/profile switches pause work and retain partial files. Bulk cancellation deletes unfinished copies; Delete All Downloads removes this profile's saved videos, never server originals. Completion notices open authorized details without autoplay. Offline Mode is shared on this device, pauses transfers/online services and restricts Home/libraries/Search/Watchlist to authorized usable copies. Plex Home needs prior online sign-in for its unchanged binding and retains protected PIN checks. Dismissing a notice changes neither mode nor connectivity; reconnect with the mode off for pending history updates. Apple TV has no downloads.

profiles.summary: Separate app profiles/server users/Apple TV system users, mobile editing/switching, profile locks/Plex PIN reuse and automatic startup trust. With TV automatic sign-in off, background browsing returns to selection immediately if any profile is protected, otherwise after five minutes with multiple profiles; playback/handoff and inactive-only interruptions are exempt. Choose a Jellyfin/Emby sign-in or Plex Home user in Libraries through TV Watching as or mobile picker/identity rows. Plex identity also selects whose Watchlist is read and written. Explicitly choosing Don't use this server's watchlist excludes that contribution, not browsing/playback; disable and re-enable the server in Libraries to reconsider and choose a user. Do not equate every mobile sheet dismissal with an explicit decline. Add Another User/Add Another Plex Account authenticates an existing identity, adding shared device credentials rather than creating a server user. Confirm the identity/libraries and honor Plex PIN checks. Add your Plex Home profiles? offers Add all profiles or Just me on both platforms. Profiles added/Profiles ready advances automatically to Choose your profile after import; Just me opens Choose your Plex user with Back available. Bulk import creates or reuses profiles by existing Home-user binding, not a display-name match; only the selected viewer proceeds through authorization/setup. Other imported profiles remain awaiting setup, not unlocked or automatically Kids. Kids Profile and the household Parental PIN require separate configuration. Library discovery switches do not remove account-wide Continue Watching/Next Up or impose server maturity restrictions. A household PIN enforces Kids settings/switching and Seerr admin-request gates. Kids playlist sources stay blocked until a PIN exists and each source is approved on that device, independently of general Kids-restriction enforcement. Approvals are whole-source, local and identity-bound, not ratings filtering. No forgotten-PIN reset is wired; another device must already permit unlocked editing to remove a synced lock.

sync.summary: Distinguish CloudKit configuration, encrypted tracker tokens, mobile Keychain adoption, provider-limited nearby transfer and Silo approval. Apple TV fetches enabled cloud sync on foreground rather than relying on background delivery. Explain network/permission/code-verification requirements and separate cross-server history. Default-on cross-server history mirrors eligible normal-title changes only to matching accessible copies; extras/trailers remain origin-only and do not emit tracker history. Queued failures retry with the captured original profile/server identities authorized; local card changes do not prove every server accepted an update. Share progress and Plex-extra fallback records persist per profile/account/viewer on the current device, not through iCloud configuration sync. Watchlist filters and sort order are transferable profile preferences, separately from membership; the allowlisted WatchlistBrowsePreferencesStore key travels with profile snapshots. Display Size, navigation style and main shortcut arrangement stay local per profile, as does Apple TV accidental-exit prevention, rather than syncing or transferring; library-tab order does transfer. Downloads/startup/Video buffer/Live TV buffer/Top Shelf remain local too. Prefer lossless audio stays local across Plozz profiles and is excluded from transfer because it depends on connected equipment. Diagnostics consent is neither synced nor transferred and is not profile-owned. External-player selection is device-wide and local; returned progress stays with the authorized original viewer/server. Live TV source copies sync encrypted per profile; account-imported M3U files and Kids approvals stay local, schedules need snapshots, and legacy source import differs from account import. Refresh Breakdown shows encoded local payload/count snapshots, not iCloud storage: include pending uploads/catalogue schedules; exclude pending deletions/downloaded IPTV guides and separate Keychain/Trakt records. On all three platforms iCloud Sync > Troubleshooting offers Reload From iCloud and destructive Reset Sync; distinguish downloading shared settings from replacing them with this device's copy. Retain erase/re-upload prevention and mobile Keychain erasure. Transferable presentation preferences grant neither access nor unsupported modes.

tracking.summary: Connect profile-owned video/anime/music trackers and check media/account/build eligibility. Distinguish outbound playback-to-history scrobbling from readable/writable Watchlists: Plozz does not import a tracker's complete watch history into media servers. Supported external returns can deliver unfinished Trakt pause progress through the durable watch outbox; finished returns keep normal history reporting. Mark as Unwatched does not delete Trakt history. WeTrakr is enabled by the production flag but still requires configured client credentials; its settings, both playback fan-outs and planning-list destination are wired. Document its authorization, Watchlist behavior, Retry/profile-wide Reconnect and failed-revocation recovery without promising the row in an unconfigured build.

requests.summary: Configure authorized Seerr and each profile's acting user; explain quotas, relinking and standard requests versus offline downloads or 4K requests. TMDB-matched library shows expose season request/status on Apple TV and Manage Seasons on mobile: request a season/All Missing, refresh status and handle failure/decline in Seerr. Requested · Unreleased indicates an approved request with a known future release and no reported download activity, not a promised download start; pending requests remain distinct. Kids/admin checks run in both shells/ProfileStore but unrestricted admin requests require a household Parental PIN to block them; also choose a restricted Seerr user. Release & Availability is independent of request status, playable ownership and paid-service entitlement.

metadata.summary: Explain shared metadata priorities/disablement, local TMDB credential verification, profile artwork choices and source/build-dependent review scores. Mobile Screens & Navigation > Movie & show details > Rating sources & order enables individual header score sources; SwiftUI Edit/Done changes priority through list reordering. The profile's enabled sources and maximum count constrain available scores. AniList remains anime-only. Provider-display scores retain server sortRank rather than the custom priority. Jellyfin details can prefer valid cached MDBList Ratings plugin scores in server-supplied order, without a new Plozz key/toggle or upstream refresh; absent/failed/invalid results retain ordinary enrichment. Home can reuse already-cached plugin ratings. Emby does not use this API. Show content ratings is a default-on profile setting under Screens & Navigation > All screens; turning it off hides classifications on Home/details/Top Shelf, not review scores or Common Sense guidance, and never enforces access restrictions. Common Sense detail requires viewing-account Plex Pass. Shares support matching video-stem NFO, show-root tvshow.nfo and named local artwork after rescan/metadata work, subject to unambiguous supported associations and artwork policy. Cache clearing affects lookup data/derived images, not downloads or server matching. External-title Release & Availability shows device-region releases and TMDB/JustWatch offers, independently of Seerr, playable ownership and subscriptions; missing offers do not prove unavailability.

help.summary: Keep symptom checks and reset/cache scopes non-destructive. Incomplete library results offer Details/Try Again, while Home row statuses offer Details/Retry without discarding saved choices; No streams found rechecks inventory, not playback. Restore saved sign-ins without deleting connections; Plex Home can require the original account, not a PIN reset. Cover Discord/GitHub/mobile email, duplicate checks and safe reproduction/device/source details. Startup diagnostics choices both continue; reporting defaults off and needs current consent plus a configured endpoint. Share Diagnostics is device-wide, not profile-owned or transferred. Send Diagnostics offers Enable Sharing when off; consenting enables reporting without submitting the manual report. Both platforms then use Message (required) and Send to Developer; blank messages disable Send and CrashDiagnostics rejects them. Automatic Sentry reports include fixed screen categories/performance evidence but exclude identity/server/media/history. Explicit submissions include allowlisted activity, search, connection, preparation, failed-library-load and retained playback/source evidence, not free-form Recent Activity messages. Search evidence excludes query text, names and URLs. The submitted message is sent as written, so exclude secrets and personal details. Export aliases are scoped to one submission. Mobile Refresh/filter/search/Copy exports an activity summary without message text, whereas local display, manual text selection and screenshots can expose server/content details. Submitted confirms SDK handoff, not receipt or a public issue. Privacy Policy is reachable in consent/Settings, with a TV QR handoff. Apple TV Home Performance Overlay is wired through MainTabView/HomeView and exposes FPS, hitches and thermal state for stutter reports; the mobile toggle has no Home renderer consumer, so do not promise a mobile overlay. Local error details need no upload consent. Settings > Release Notes remains reachable after startup notices are disabled. Show release notes on startup for new versions and the confirmed Don’t Show Again action control automatic notices, not manual access. Shared Sources > Add Source navigation replaces separate server/share add actions. IPTV guide preparation is independent of channel availability and has explicit status/recovery in the channel guide.

platforms.summary: Explain remote/touch/keyboard, VoiceOver, optional gestures, iPhone full-window orientation versus iPad system rotation, and TV fades that do not enable system matching. Player orientation choices are Follow device orientation, Portrait, Landscape auto, Landscape left and Landscape right. Follow device orientation respects system rotation lock; Landscape auto uses the active phone player's motion lease to follow sideways direction even with rotation lock enabled, with fixed choices retaining their direction. Trace NSMotionUsageDescription and the runtime full-window/phone checks rather than treating an entitlement or label as proof of iPad support. Mobile pinch switches Normal/Crop; the playback task explains session-only zoom modes. Link Apple TV's automatic-sign-in and background-browsing return checks, distinct from playback departures and brief inactive interruptions. Top Shelf offers shared local adult controls, Posters/Full Screen and 1-20 counts defaulting four; source-scoped snapshots retain authorization/spoiler limits. Trace Guide OS entry and music Now Playing commands. Distinguish live seeking/Go Live from library-channel Jump to now and recording. Live TV buffer applies on new live stream loads, not library files, and Go Live retains its latency/tuning tradeoffs. Conversion diagnostics separate active video/audio facts from original-source details; neither establishes physical speaker layout. Throughput is not encoded bitrate and temporary cache is not downloads. Retain remuxed AirPlay subtitle loss, Multiview/PiP limits and authorized external-player returns.

FeatureAuth.summary: Keep provider sign-in and verified alternate addresses in the server task. Saved-account Sign In Again is wired in both shells for Jellyfin/Plex/Emby/Silo, validates the original account/server/profile and replaces credentials without deleting the saved connection; cancellation/failure preserves it. Network retry and IPTV/share connection editing remain separate. Plex Home recovery reauthenticates the original Plex account before the intended user's normal access/PIN checks, not a PIN reset.

FeatureDiscovery.summary: Use LAN discovery or manual entry; Jellyfin/Emby public checks prefer HTTPS, try eligible HTTP alternatives before authentication and stop rather than downgrade after explicit HTTPS or TLS trust rejection. The same resolver is wired through the shared picker model into mobile AddServerView. Saved routes keep exact-address behavior. Tailscale is an externally configured connection requiring the server's IP/MagicDNS address, not a Plozz-managed VPN or discoverable LAN server.

FeatureHome.summary: Keep browsing, collection recovery, source/version selection, Watchlists and schedule-only placeholders together. Both shells resolve All Libraries through FeatureHomeCore's shared source inventory/merge policy; mobile has a reachable navigation destination but still no alphabet rail. Home row browsing is a separate reachable workflow: eligible TV See all cards/mobile headings open the original row feed through HomeRowBrowseFactory, while Watchlist routes to its existing page. Dedicated Discover instead uses DiscoverBrowseView/DiscoverRuntime in both shells, with ordered paged feeds and profile-saved Available now/Hide watched controls; its new focused guide explains access, title actions and row recovery separately from Home hero discovery. Filtering/sorting waits for the full available Home row rather than sorting only the preview; server-feed identity and current profile visibility are retained. Name-sort rail behavior is TV-only; unused menu/observed feedback state is not a mobile jump control. Library presentation, collection covers and Home rows retain independent scopes and failure recovery. Account-wide history ignores disabled-library discovery. Both shells wire detail theme music and server trailers with lifecycle/authorization checks; online trailers open YouTube externally with mobile-only web fallback. The TV Home performance overlay supports stutter reporting, not a mobile overlay. Eligible Apple TV Home/detail server previews now expand through Up with borrowed transport; Home requires Pinned Sidebar, and sound returns to the previous mute state afterward. Detail information groups expand into platform-specific readers; series catalogue totals are not available/unwatched counts.

FeatureLiveTV.summary: Cover reachable channel menus, previews, Multiviews, guide search/correction, source-scoped channel-identity review, local Kids playlist approvals and channel checks. The mobile destination wires the network policy into playback eligibility: Wi-Fi-only enforcement follows detected changes, while Low Data Mode independently pauses live playback until an unrestricted connection is available. Automatic library channels offer preparation Retry and ready-state Refresh, but no individual editing; custom channels retain their separate editor. Guide options reaches Review channel identities; confirmed historical identity is applied by the durable cache/import model and reuses saved preferences only when the old entry is absent. The playlist detail's SettingsPageLink reaches scanning; its global TV Sources destination is nested under library-channel management and unreliable. Source-copy import exists for legacy/fallback flows and syncs differently from current IPTV-account file imports; do not invent a universal alternate import procedure. Personal channel-label/preferences and the separate unavailable-favorite recovery helper have no prototype presentation route, so omit them as unusable controls without confusing them with the reachable identity review. Maintain the focused channel-organization sections, guide retention limits and source-to-IPTV-account migration; these are reachable workflows, unlike the retired personal channel editor. TV Sources/Add TV Source labels are shared with CoreUI; setup and source details expose persistent, authorized IPTV guide preparation and Refresh guide. Eligible Silo libraries participate in automatic/custom Plozz channels without supplying native Silo Live TV.

FeatureMusic.summary: Cover Apple TV server-library listening, queue controls, lyrics and Last.fm, including screensaver/background listening and Control Center transport. Explain LRCLIB title/artist/duration queries and the shared device-wide lyrics toggle that gates future lookups, including its enabled-but-no-lyrics disabled state. This privacy/scope workflow predates the current source delta and needs ongoing full-audit coverage; it is not tracker scrobbling or a new standalone page.

FeaturePlayback.summary: Use task sections for player preferences, text/image/dual-subtitle limits, confirmed caption-style replacement and live rewind. Mobile menus consolidate in portrait and separate in landscape; Advanced… owns second subtitles, delay and style, while Video owns Quality/zoom. Session-only Normal (Default)/Auto-crop black bars/Crop/Stretch/Custom zoom has an explained 50%-200% range. Chapters needs usable provider/file chapters; seeking preserves play/pause intent and episode spoilers, and thumbnails are optional. Default-on profile preferences gate Chapters, Cast, Episodes, Playlist and Continue Watching cards while retaining Info. Continue Watching uses loaded Home progress, excluding the current item and same-source episodes of its show. TV and mobile hosts prepare the selected title's authorized source/version before saving outgoing progress and replacing playback at its own position. Identify songs defaults on per profile and shows confirmed ShazamKit matches alongside Info, stacked vertically on narrow cards. Every match card opens Open song: Spotify search, conditional Apple Music, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, Deezer and TIDAL searches. TV app-opening failure shows a phone QR link; mobile opens an app/browser. Recognition consumes decoded playback audio, not microphone input, needs internet and cannot run in Offline Mode, the native engine or remote-bypass HLS. Series audio memory stores language, not an exact mix. Prefer lossless audio selects the AetherEngine adapter's lossless/surroundCompat request at each video/live load; neither the native engine nor an external app consumes this device preference, and requested mode does not guarantee actual output. Live TV buffer is a new-load cushion with latency/tuning costs, separate from library files. Neither wired engine advertises audio-delay or engine-local dialogue processing; the TV system bridge separately exposes output-gated global Reduce Loud Sounds/Enhance Dialogue and recovery. Cast page navigation ends playback. Diagnostics separate active conversion facts, original sources, measured throughput, player-window/buffer values and temporary cache without claiming physical speaker layout. PlayerScreenshotHook and LiveChannelScreenshotHook only preselect panels for internal capture; they expose no reader screenshot workflow. BorrowedTrailerPlayer supplies standard TV transport to an existing hero preview without a provider session, track menus or watch-history reporting; speed and zoom are its advertised engine capabilities.

FeatureProfiles.summary: Cover profile setup, entry/edit authorization, Kids restrictions and device-local automatic sign-in. Apple TV's separate browsing-return policy is wired through foreground protection, profile flow and RootView: automatic sign-in off permits immediate protected-profile checks or a five-minute unprotected multi-profile timeout, excluding playback departures and inactive-only interruptions. Plex Home onboarding offers bulk import or Just me without authenticating other imported users; the brief import confirmation advances automatically to Choose your profile, while Just me opens Choose your Plex user. New profiles carry isAwaitingSetup and their own Home-user binding, not automatically a Kids flag. The selected viewer must still complete authorization and setup. The Forgot PIN strings in ProfileLockCopy have no presentation call site; both the shared entry PIN screen and management actions lack a reset control. Do not promise recovery from unused labels; another device must already have unlocked editing access before removing a synced lock.

FeatureSearch.summary: Global search retains its library task; consent-scoped provider categories, counts, timing and request failures also support manual diagnostic reports without storing query text, content names, URLs or provider identifiers. This is diagnostic evidence, not uploaded search history or a promise to retain search sessions across restarts.

FeatureSettings.summary: Group by task and platform/provider applicability, not by toggle. Preserve Home Rows/Add row, separate watched-content Filtering, current Home/Libraries/Movie & show details paths and TV navigation layouts/shortcut recovery. Keep shared Card labels, independent Logo/Text sizing, spoilers and classification controls distinct from restrictions. Collection-cover shapes have independent library/Recommended/Home scopes and do not style titles within collections. Detail music works in both shells; audio explains volume, preview/generated fallback and mobile session mute. Prefer lossless audio has an output-compatibility section, retaining default, device scope, adapter wiring, new-load timing and hardware limits. Profiles covers TV/mobile server users and adding shared sign-ins without creating users. Skipping, independent buffers, saved-sign-in recovery and sync-data sizes stay in their tasks. Feedback explains Share Diagnostics, Enable Sharing without submission, Message (required), Send to Developer and Submitted's SDK-handoff limit, plus privacy and TV Home stutter measurements. Reload/reset are reachable in both sync troubleshooting UIs. External-player choice retains its focused guide for device scope, eligibility, token sharing and returned progress. Low-risk sort/recently-watched controls need no new pages. Developer Mode and Reset to First Run are hidden diagnostic/setup-retest surfaces gated by DeveloperModeModel in both settings shells, not routine recovery procedures; omit their unlock/reset steps rather than recommending destructive setup erasure. Home hero and Movie & show details now share Trailers & music: source policy, independent Home autoplay and detail background, conditional mute controls and theme-volume preview. Landscape collection rows additionally expose Logo On/Off, default Off.

FeatureSyncCloud.summary: Separate settings/profile/media/tracker channels from mobile Keychain adoption. Profile snapshots explicitly include Watchlist filter/sort preferences, independently of saved-title membership. Profile preference capture excludes device-specific density, main navigation and exit/zoom settings; their per-profile stores do not make them transferable. Prefer lossless audio likewise stays local but is shared across profiles on the device. Offline Mode is also device-local and shared by profiles; mobile cloud publishing/loading and Keychain credential publishing/adoption are explicitly paused while it is active and resume after it is disabled. Live TV source secrets/imported source chunks are encrypted; sync cannot grant local parental approval or materialize an account-imported M3U on another device. Explain on-demand local payload/count snapshots and their exclusions without representing them as CloudKit storage usage. Keep destructive reset/erase warnings and schedule catalogue requirements.

FeatureSyncSetup.summary: Explain reachable receiver/sender setup, local network and scan permissions, code/QR alternatives, conditional verification and provider transfer limits. Same-account rendezvous and scanned QR pin the recipient key; ordinary links do not silently bypass verification.

FeatureWatchlist.summary: The focused Watchlist guide covers saving, removal, navigation, filtering and sorting on Apple TV/iPhone/iPad. Shared UI exposes All/Movies/TV Shows, Clear Filters, Date Added/Release Date/Name and Order. Save dates are distinct from library import; undated entries follow dated entries. The profile-scoped browse model and transfer allowlist preserve those choices, independently of Home row order. Document explicit saves plus enabled-destination contributions, minus explicit removals. Jellyfin/Emby contribute Favorites; Plex and Silo contribute Watchlists. Disabling a server retracts native contributions without erasing explicit saves. Plex user selection determines native identity; decline excludes that list without disabling browsing/playback, and disabling/re-enabling clears the decline for another choice. Confirmed native-list removals after acknowledged additions can propagate; genuine re-adds can supersede removal. Failed reads/deliveries are not confirmed deletions and are retried. Pending Removing and optimistic local confirmation are not proof that every remote destination accepted the change. Native timestamps, release-date payloads and ownership enrichment support this workflow, not another settings page.

MediaDownloads.summary: Explain network/speed/provider limits and completed-copy validation: Finishing or all bytes received is not Downloaded. Selection uses source/item/version identities; episodes can save several copies while movies are single-select, and Ask Each Time cannot bypass batch/multiversion review. Original keeps embedded tracks. New reduced Plex/Emby/Silo copies require all reported audio, validated before completion; formats can change. Emby packages separately prepared compressed audio with converted video and needs temporary storage. Silo rejects an incomplete or changed exact-file audio inventory. Jellyfin reduced copies may keep one track; saved older preparations retain inclusion flags on retry. Jellyfin and Emby without all-audio support require uncapped rendition transfer; new all-audio Emby uses rate-limited/background HTTP. Management is copy-specific; playback tries matching usable copies with the requested version first, even after another server is selected. Background HTTP differs from share work and continued processing remains an OS decision. Profile changes pause transfers; returning resumes under network policy. Movie/episode menus manage a copy; show menus manage a group, and the saved-show Edit/Select All/Remove flow confirms selected episode deletion without touching originals. OfflineMediaProvider reconstructs authorized movies/shows/seasons/episodes from completed physically usable records, artwork, supported local subtitles and local progress. Offline Mode replaces mobile browsing and filters Watchlist without deleting online saves; it is shared on this device. Plex Home's prior-online-sign-in proof is binding-specific and never bypasses a protected PIN or authorizes a new identity. Sidecars share the version/profile folder and removal lifecycle. Supported SRT/VTT/ASS/SSA text, 64 tracks, 16 MiB per file and 64 MiB total are implementation limits; partial warnings keep usable video/good prior sidecars. Subtitle-only updates recheck authorization/network/speed without retransferring video. Explicit-version offline selection never silently substitutes another saved version.

MediaTransportCore.omitReason: Internal file-system capability and bounded-read contracts expose no independent reader setting or procedure. Protocol selection, authentication, scanning and download limits are documented under connections and offline viewing instead.

MediaTransportFTP.summary: Cover FTP and manually addressed implicit FTPS in the share task; composition does not produce explicit AUTH TLS connections. Direct external playback is VLC-only for compatible plain FTP and credential encoding, not FTPS. Other eligible regular files can instead use the separately documented authorized mobile share relay; Apple TV has no such background relay.

MediaTransportHTTP.omitReason: Shared HTTP sessions and trust/range plumbing are not a separately selectable library type in the add-share UI. Document their consequential range/validator requirements in network-shares#webdav-lists-files-but-will-not-play, not as another source or an internal-settings procedure.

MediaTransportNFS.summary: State the wired NFSv3 requirement and export-based access rules in the network-share procedure, not a separate protocol guide.

MediaTransportWebDAV.summary: A wired share transport, not a media server. Successful listings can lack required playback validators. Network shares explains bounded HTTP responses, strong ETag or valid Last-Modified, administrator/proxy checks and rescan/reopen after replacement. Source changes fail closed. Direct external playback requires an independent compatible HTTP URL with supported anonymous/signed or Basic authorization and system certificate trust; custom links exclude password-bearing URLs. Pinned trust, bearer/custom headers and incompatible password encoding prevent direct handoff. Eligible mobile regular files can use the separate authorized background relay instead.

MetadataKit.summary: Keep provider ordering/cache controls in metadata, lyric availability and LRCLIB title/artist/duration sharing in music, and community skips in playback. The music area traces the device-wide toggle into the lyric resolver's online-query gate. Home explains selecting public Discovery catalogues independently of Seerr requests, with Kids restrictions and no implied playable ownership. This is recommendation discovery, not the FeatureDiscovery module's LAN server search. Marker requests include applicable title/episode metadata and runtime, not video uploads; server markers and third-party coverage remain distinct. Regional releases/watch offers are populated only for external/discovery details and rendered independently of Seerr; explain them beside title requests without requiring a request connection. TMDB's authorized videos API can supply trailer links after server-owned files and server metadata are considered; it does not verify YouTube availability. Explain the reachable external handoff in library, not a nonexistent streaming-trailer provider or scraping workflow.

ProviderIPTV.summary: Keep playlist/Xtream and EPG setup, scoped guide credentials, local account-file imports, guide-only operation and optional on-demand catalogues in existing source/library tasks. HTTP/proxy/parsing diagnostics do not add a selectable source type. Explicit account setup starts authorized guide preparation beyond the sheet lifetime; stage/current-listing status and Refresh guide recovery differ from channel availability. External-player handoff admits on-demand movies/episodes only when their playable URL needs no extra headers and the request needs no reduced/forced conversion; it excludes live channels and does not add IPTV downloads.

ProviderJellyfin.summary: Keep provider sign-in, library and music behavior in their tasks. The optional Jellyfin-only server-ratings seam reads same-origin authenticated MDBList Ratings CachedByItemId data without fetching upstream services or running plugin refresh/scripts. Detail enrichment prefers valid nonempty results with fallback on absence/failure; Home consumes already-cached results. No new Plozz token or switch is required, and this API must not be inferred for Emby.

ProviderPlex.summary: Plex library, quality, music and guidance remain provider-specific. Extras retain their own identity and do not complete the main title or fan out to trackers/matching copies. Explicitly classified Plex extras receive durable local progress fallback isolated by profile, account and server user, surviving provider refresh on this device. LocalMediaWatchStore keeps at most 2,000 newest records within its payload budget, so older fallback positions can be evicted. A newer usable server history record takes precedence. The library extras section and sync history section explain the reader-visible behavior without promising unlimited retention or cloud transfer of local fallback.

ProviderShare.summary: Network shares covers connection/scanning, Personal Videos and local NFO/artwork association. Keep your place explains durable profile/account-local watched/resume state on this device, separate from iCloud preferences and matching-copy history propagation. LocalMediaWatchStore retains at most 2,000 newest records per profile/source and may retain fewer within its payload budget; eviction can remove old marks/positions. Dismissal from Continue Watching preserves resume; later playback restores eligibility. Imported streaming-service titles use one allowlisted HTTPS title URL in a UTF-8 .strmlnk file up to 8192 bytes; select its source/version and the destination-specific action or Open Link. ExternalMediaLink validates service hosts/title paths. TV requires an installed universal-link app; mobile uses app/browser routing. Opening rechecks authorization and reports Couldn't Open Link rather than starting a stream. Such links create no external-player receipt or automatic returned progress and cannot download; service access/regions remain outside Plozz. Ordinary playable share files separately support compatible direct WebDAV/plain-FTP handoff or a mobile relay. The relay requires a real iOS/iPadOS 26 background grant, a regular immutable file and a noncustom installed player. It excludes playlists, .strm links, ISO and BDMV; returning Plozz to foreground or losing execution/authorization stops the connection. Local metadata precedence and ambiguous-folder rejection are source-verified. Complete decrypted BDMV folders are one title using the index identity and movie-root metadata; disc-playback explains menus/videos, which never gain downloads or external handoff.

ProviderSilo.summary: Silo library channels are reachable on all platforms through shared automatic/custom channel management. Server capability/permission checks require available protocol-3 original-file delivery; eligible single-file versions need reliable runtime/size and are revalidated before playback. Channel transport suppresses ordinary resume writes; default-off completion reporting is separate. Silo still has no native Live TV. Separately, on-demand original/converted streams now support external handoff when account authorization and the playback grant cover the full duration plus the safety margin; incompatible delivery stays in Plozz. New reduced downloads require the complete exact-file audio inventory and reject incomplete/changed prepared tracks; older saved preparations keep their inclusion flags.

SeerService.summary: Keep request permissions and profile-user mapping in media requests. A configured connection also supplies the separate Discover destination's movie/show feeds; browsing can use public metadata discovery when no Seerr connection is configured. A configured connection's failure stays visible rather than switching providers, and its availability flags do not replace verification of playable library copies.

TopShelfKit.summary: Document Apple TV placement, local shared visibility/layout/count preferences, same-copy deduplication, playback versus details actions and current access checks. The carousel buttons have OS-owned captions, not verified app labels. Full-screen metadata uses known source facts, series artwork and spoiler policy, never a guarantee of output or a live server browser. Poster/backdrop composition is infrastructure, not another reader control.

TraktService.summary: Separate Watchlist sync, completed watches and partial pause progress returned by supported external players. Mark as Unwatched does not delete Trakt history. Shared sign-in recovery belongs in trackers; receipt/debug response plumbing needs no separate user procedure.

WetrakrService.summary: Production-enabled but configuration-gated video tracking and planning-list read/write integration is reachable on both platforms. Cover authorization and connection recovery in trackers and list propagation in library. View on WeTrakr, when present for imported entries, is an external link/TV QR handoff rather than media playback; this self-explanatory link needs no standalone guide.

Internet, active supported playback and route checks apply; Offline Mode prevents recognition. Default-on Prefer lossless audio is shared on this device, not synced/transferred; disabling requests compressed surround-compatible AetherEngine output for newly loaded video/live streams, not a guaranteed hardware format or native/external setting. Video buffer and separate Live TV buffer affect new loads, not downloads. Its information action explains ranking without another mode. Advanced > External player is device-wide; the reference explains compatible original/converted streams, expanded provider/share routes, actual mobile background-grant requirements, token/password sharing, fallback and authorized progress returns. Discs precedes Advanced; the profile defaults to Play video, with Open disc menu for attemptable share folders and one-time held-play alternatives. App navigation owns Pinned Sidebar/Sidebar/Top Bar, delayed style application, library shortcuts, explicit Show and Settings recovery; layout/shortcuts stay local.
