Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackDiagnosticDetails.navigation: Choose Details on a playback failure, then Share details if needed.
Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackDiagnosticDetails.experience: Read the captured failure and export its diagnostics after checking private information.
Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackDiagnosticDetails.conditions: Only captured failures have evidence. Sharing details is explicit and different from automatic consented crash reports.

Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackFailureView.swift.navigation: Encounter a video failure during supported Plozz playback.
Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackFailureView.swift.experience: Read the failure and open its diagnostic details rather than assuming a successful empty player.
Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackFailureView.swift.conditions: Shown only on an actual failure; messages and recovery depend on the failing source/path.

Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackResumePrompt.swif.navigation: Start an in-progress video with Ask to resume or start over enabled.
Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackResumePrompt.swif.experience: Choose Resume or Start Over, using displayed duration information when available.
Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackResumePrompt.swif.conditions: Requires saved progress and the profile prompt preference; runtimes may be unknown and editions can differ.

Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackSourceMenu.swift.navigation: Open a title's ellipsis More actions menu on Apple TV or iPhone/iPad.
Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackSourceMenu.swift.experience: Choose an authorized server copy, playable file version or imported external title link.
Sources/CoreUI/PlaybackSourceMenu.swift.conditions: Server appears only with multiple server choices. With multiple versions, Source replaces Version if any version is an external link; its destination heading is Sources instead of Versions. Server names, service names and edition descriptions are dynamic. Offline sources are disabled. The selected share's link opens outside Plozz, unlike a playable file. A matching validated offline copy on mobile can take precedence for playable media; changing server does not force streaming.

The explanation describes resolution/HDR/bitrate and device compatibility plus enabled remembered-series priority; it is not another selection mode or a freestanding navigation destination.

Sources/FeatureAuth/QuickConnectView.swi.conditions: Jellyfin Quick Connect availability is server-dependent. Only approve the device/code you intended to connect.

Sources/FeatureAuth/ServerAddressesView..navigation: Open Settings > Sources, select a server, then Connection addresses > Add or manage addresses.
Sources/FeatureAuth/ServerAddressesView..experience: Verify a trusted alternative endpoint, inspect saved addresses, or remove an unwanted address.
Sources/FeatureAuth/ServerAddressesView..conditions: Supported server connections only; addresses belong to this sign-in/device. Explicit HTTPS failures are not permission to downgrade; HTTP is unencrypted.

controls.text: Addresses are saved for this sign-in on this device.
Plex also discovers its own local, remote, and relay addresses automatically.

Sources/FeatureAuth/SiloSignInView.swift.navigation: Choose a Silo server from discovery or a manually entered address.
Sources/FeatureAuth/SiloSignInView.swift.experience: Open the Silo approval page, approve this device, choose the intended Silo profile and enter its PIN if required.
Sources/FeatureAuth/SiloSignInView.swift.conditions: Silo requires device-specific authorization; copying setup or signing into another device does not authorize this device. Mobile opens the approval link locally and offers Use another device to expand the alternate address/code instructions. Apple TV shows QR/address instructions alongside the code. Approval requires an enabled standalone source and the household PIN; it is device-local and is not offered for IPTV accounts, which use server-source enrollment. New setup and Connect as IPTV account use that account path; conversion is URL-only and leaves the older standalone source saved, without transferring its approval protection. Mapping requires durable storage and guides; identity review needs candidates. Account details instead offer Use this source, Rename source, Live TV status, conditional Refresh guide and removal, not standalone editing/mapping/scanning/approval. Refresh guide requires an authorized IPTV account and is disabled while loading or off. Disabling/removing cancels pending guide work; dismissing the notice does not. Channel choices and account sign-ins survive source removal. The enabled source needs runtime status before its inline terminal status appears; stage progress uses the shared notice. Guide ready covers current listings, not every channel/date.

Sources/FeatureSettings/PreferenceDetail.navigation: Choose Playback, Subtitles, Appearance, Screens & Navigation or Language in Apple TV Settings. The control inventory walks those workspaces in that order, keeping nested picker choices beside their parent and alternative branches together. Row-builder titles that are not rendered by the active workspace are not extra visible headings.
Sources/FeatureSettings/PreferenceDetail.experience: Navigate profile settings workspaces in visible order. Playback begins with Audio, Autoplay & Up Next, then Player tabs before version selection and buffers. Player tabs lists Chapters, Cast, Episodes, Playlist and Continue Watching, default on per profile; usable content still gates tabs and Info is always retained. Audio places Identify songs after Prefer lossless audio; default-on Shazam recognition needs internet and supported playback and does not use microphone capture. Version selection offers Choose on first play while unset, then Ask every time, Choose automatically and Use first from server in enum order; its information accessory always opens How automatic selection works on Apple TV and the alert closes with Done. In Customize labels, Only show descriptions on focus follows Episodes only on Apple TV's Movie & show details page; it starts off, is disabled when episode labels are off, and changes synopsis visibility without changing spoiler policy.
Sources/FeatureSettings/PreferenceDetail.conditions: Apple TV workspace order: Playback has Audio, Autoplay & Up Next, Player tabs, Version selection, Remember series version choices, Video buffer, Live TV buffer, Skip intros, credits & more, Seeking, Fade on display changes, Discs, Advanced. Audio defaults, Autoplay and Skip Intervals are internal row-builder titles, not separate headings in this workspace. Separate audio/subtitle rules replace the base picker with Movies, TV Shows, Anime and Everything else; language names come from the language catalogue. Time before the end needs Show Up Next card. Subtitle order is Show subtitles, Subtitle style, Live TV subtitle style, Subtitle language, SDH subtitles, Downloading subtitles, Remember subtitles per series. Customize Live TV subtitles requires a separate style. Downloading subtitles appears for supported server profiles; unsupported profiles see its prerequisite only through a matching search. Skip-marker Customize requires skipping enabled; category switches gate marker-specific rules, where Use default and Off appear. Appearance has Theme, Cards, Artwork, Circadian Mode; Screens & Navigation has App navigation, All screens, Home, Libraries, Movie & show details, Music player. Theme uses AppTheme.pickerOrder: Black, Dark, Light, System. Music player instead uses Dark, Pure Black, Light, Match Theme, followed by Show album, quality & lyrics source. Provider management shortcuts are hidden without permission; engine/platform conditions gate playback and subtitle options. Cards contains Labels, Watch indicators, Focus, Style, Display Size; Focus choices are System, Highlight, Outline. Presets replace label overrides; the compact Custom readout is iOS-only. Customize labels from Cards offers all nine Page choices; from Movie & show details it contains Episodes, Related titles and Extras without a Page picker. Home/Recommended use Default with On/Off/Mixed, followed by Overrides; Continue Watching and Home's Libraries use Use default/On/Off. Other pages use On/Off only. Apple TV cycles these row choices on selection; mobile presents a picker. The color picker is hidden with Hidden watch indicators; Episode count style appears only with episode counts enabled. Trailers & music is the shared nested destination, reached from Movie & show details or an enabled Home hero. Nested controls are audited here and on HeroSettingsControls in UI order: Trailers policy (Off, Server only, Server + YouTube), Home autoplay with its conditional Start muted, then Details with Detail background (Off, Trailer, Theme music), its separate conditional Start muted, or Theme music volume and preview controls. Off disables trailers/autoplay but not music or other extras; YouTube is manual/external only. The settings are profile-specific and the Home/detail choices are independent. Playback exposes Discs before Advanced. Disc playback defaults to Play video and is a profile preference; Open disc menu affects attemptable network-share BDMV folders only. The helper warns that only HDMV menus are supported and menu videos do not update watch progress. Unsupported menu metadata selects video instead; the DEBUG-only BD-J switch is not production support.
